## Core Offerings
1. **Custom Web Development:** Responsive web applications and fast landing pages built with clean code architectures using React, Node.js, and REST APIs.
2. **Creative UI/UX Design:** User interface mockups, wireframes, custom visual styles, and responsive mobile-first layouts designed in Figma.
3. **E-Commerce Solutions:** Scalable online storefronts with secure checkouts and integrations (Next.js, Shopify, Stripe, PayPal).
4. **Performance & SEO:** Google Lighthouse speed optimizations, structural schema injection, and keyword-focused on-page copywriting to rank high on US search engines.

## Key Projects
